conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: This instantaneous correlation is one of the most puzzling and intriguing aspects of quantum mechanics, famously referred to by Einstein as "spooky action at a distance." It has been experimentally verified numerous times.
